players.name: Michael Mota
players.bio: Hey its the me, i have very very guilty conscience that won't let me sleep at night. send help

pc.title: Gill
pc.content: Gill, the triton artificer, came to the Copper Dawn festival to explore the city and see what inventions could be made. He met Elly and joined the party's commission for the Celestial Droplet. He often watches Riven perform by the seaside from a distance while trying to put the puzzle in his head together. The magic affecting Gill seems to be a topic banned by the Celestials. Raised by Meryll the mermaid. Gill inventions include a spear that returns to him, a upgrade to corey weapon and a turtle named robert

pc.title: Corelia Harrendyl
pc.content: Aasimar Samurai Fighter, a friend of Mozzie the devil, currently looking for an item that used to belong to her family. Helped interrogate Gill into the party. She has been hearing voices: "Return the final piece, and reawaken the ship." They have stopped once we got the ship

pc.title: Riven
pc.content: The sea elf bard that cannot go into the sea, likely because of a curse from some kind of powerful being/god. He loves the sea, but the sea does not love him; bad things happen if he enters the water. He was once part of a troupe with Elly and Blue (possibly childhood friends), now bartends at the Royal Seadog, and seems connected to information/criminal circles. The person tied to the curse may have been someone he loved named Lori. He has not been home for around 100 years as a result.

pc.title: Rahkar
pc.content: Student of Talon Malsir. Originally from the Shadowfell. May have noble heritage, unsure. Hears voices in his head and is prone to spontaneous teleporting and wild surges. Raven King apparently tried to warn his family. Parents are dead. insane

pc.title: Blue
pc.content: Sapphire dragonborn bard (Blue/Tiff, with Tiff seeming to be a personal name). Was once part of a troupe with Riven and Elly. Alandra said it feels like two people are constantly present around Blue, and Blue's dreams are very present: "Someone is constantly betraying you, and they don't know it themselves."

npc.title: Talon Malsir
npc.content: One of the great heroes, a wild-magic sorcerer who helped defeat the Pale Silence, now a resident celebrity living in Alsicta, mentor/master of Rahkar. Father of Soren Malsir. Seems to have issues; best not to press. At one point, he encountered the dragonborn known as the Golden Flame, possibly the original one. He also announced the hunt for the Celestial Droplet on behalf of Alsita's government.

npc.title: Unknown Captain of the Riverwalker/Former
npc.content: Seen in a vision (the same one Corelia saw). Going by an alias right now, cannot remember his name. His first mate is not here (the other one in the vision). Remembers vaguely the man he traveled with and believes his friend was not a good person. Was able to sense some sort of magic from Blue and Riven, then associated it with Gill. He and Gill are on much better terms now.

npc.title: Hubert
npc.content: Hobo, friend of Blue, old man from the alleyway with Blue. Former sailor with naval experience and now acting captain of the party ship.

npc.title: jonik
npc.content: The wood elf whom we met at the inn. Ask Riven about his opinion on current events. Part of the High Council and head of military in Pinchchester. Was once affected by a white tentacle.

npc.title: The Golden Flame
npc.content: TACOS, HE'S A MEXICAN. Owns a mansion. Fights. Wants a cape that does not belong to him. This cape seems to have belonged to the original Golden Flame.

npc.title: High council of pinchchester
npc.content: Jonik is part of this group and appears to serve as military leadership.

npc.title: Thea
npc.content: A paladin. A triton. A wife. Can communicate with souls. Co-authored The Big Book by annotating Shelly's science. rummored to have abilty to influcnece souls

npc.title: Shelly
npc.content: A terrorist. Wrote The Big Book. Wife of Thea. Gill is a big fan of her because of her book and inventions.

npc.title: Mira Dahlien
npc.content: Matriarch of the Dahlien Family. She co-owns the WayFarer Tavern with her husband Akris; her family works there alongside her and the demon Mozzie. Family order (oldest to youngest): Elazar, Pride, Euphie, Pura, Sol. Mira asked Corelia to look after Nero and see if he will come home one day.

npc.title: The orginal Golden Flame
npc.content: A long time ago there was a hero known as the Golden Flame, a golden dragonborn. We know not much about this man, but we do know he fought the hero known as Talon. A statue of him stands in the Tomb of Rememberance.

npc.title: Gate crasher
npc.content: Fist of the Golden Mountain. Friend of Jonik. Connected to Jonik's catacomb request; his remains were tied to the requested rapier retrieval.

npc.title: tom riddle(Rhaekar main voice)
npc.content: The main voice in Rahkar's head; he may be in the Vault of Rindos.

npc.title: Elyndra "Elly" Sollace
npc.content: Aasimar with red hair and a wing tattoo (one angel wing, one devil wing). Former troupe member with Riven and Blue. The one who brought Gill and the party onto the Celestial Droplet commission. Takes 10% of commission cuts. In debt to Captain Dreadtooth and magically bound from sharing full details; not paying means death.

npc.title: Mozzie
npc.content: Rakshasa samurai and mentor to Corelia. Connected to the Wayfarer/Dahlien circle. Hates the Deepguard. Left a note telling Corelia to reject Elly's ship deal and hinted he can provide a "real ship." (i am pretty sure he hates or at very least strongly dislikes gill, 75 percent sure)

npc.title: Xim
npc.content: Elvish ancestry with green hair. Talks about memory/mind like puzzles and may access thoughts or dreams. About Blue: memories feel incomplete. About Riven: dreams are terrifying/alive, refuses to interact directly. Mentions someone is in the Vault and does not want to find it.

npc.title: Raven King
npc.content: Not associated with the Raven Queen. Appears to offer guidance to Rahkar and discuss fear, prophecy, and misunderstood power.

event.title: DREAM BATTLES
event.content: For some reason, in Riven's dreams, he has been dragging party members into his dreams to fight some sort of shadow demon. Currently, Corelia and Rahkar have been sent into these dreams. Mozzie showed up to aid Corelia, and Rahkar got a boost from his voices in his head. Xim described Riven's dreams as terrifying and almost alive.

event.title: The quest from jonik
event.content: He has certain access to things under the city where they buried the honored dead: sewers, catacombs, offerings/treasure, the Tomb of Rememberance. He wanted something returned to him (a rapier) and warned us about undead, cave-ins, and a locked gate tied to Gate Crasher. The rapier is with the body of Gate Crasher.

event.title: Skeleton from cave
event.content: Skeleton with three eyes, an aboleth killed by gate crasher.

event.title: Riverwalker Reawakening Lead
event.content: Visions and translated notes point to a goal: unearth the last fragment of the ship that cannot be sunk, reunite it with the ship's corpse, and reawaken it. Corelia's voices align with this objective.

enemy.title: Shadow Demon
enemy.content: WHAT THE FUCK WAS THAT, IT WAS AFTER BLUE AND RIVEN AND SARAH AS THEY BROKE SOMEWHERE, IT WAS SCARY, IDK. Might be connected to recurring dream/nightmare attacks around Riven.

enemy.title: Dreadtooth
enemy.content: A famous pirate who hunts those who make deals with him. He cuts ships in half. He made a deal with Elly and is now looking to talk with Gill. Arron (they/them) seems to work for/with him. He presents himself as someone of the sea and may control tides/shores through his vessel and sword.

enemy.title: Rindos
enemy.content: An ancient black dragon that is attacking the continent; he has many worshippers and a cult.

enemy.title: Weird slimy thing
enemy.content: A slimy enemy, Mozzie took the enemy; he and his kind appeared during the Pale Silence, as remembered by Riven. We first found this enemy in Pinchchester, in the Tomb of Rememberance.

enemy.title: Yuan Ti Malison
enemy.content: Recurring snake-hybrid enemies linked to current attacks and likely tied to dream/nightmare disturbances. Types observed: snake upper body, snake-armed human body, and mostly snake form variants.

enemy.title: The Deepguard
enemy.content: Criminal organization Mozzie really hates. Suspected in violent operations and manipulation around informants.

enemy.title: Zalbog of the Black Blessing
enemy.content:
Black dragonborn with pale discoloration around the face with green eyes
2500 gp murderer, fanatic of Rindos

location.title: The royal seadog
location.content: A bar in Alsicta. Riven bartends here and seems to run information contacts out of it.

location.title: Gildhammer
location.content: There was an illitid problem. Draves. Also noted as Godrian's original home.

location.title: the tomb of remeberance
location.content: Catacombs under the city of Pinchester. In one of the rooms lies 4 statues at the four corners: one for the Golden Flame, one for the hero known as the Tempest (destroyed), one known as the Matriarch (Riven seems to have something with the statue as if he knew her), and one that looks like Former. In one of the rooms lies a picture of a snake with wings.

location.title: Pinchchester
location.content: The city of heroes. Connected to Jonik, the High Council, and missions into the Tomb of Rememberance.

location.title: Wayfarer Tavern
location.content: Tavern in Alsita co-owned by Mira and Akris Dahlien. Regular base point for Dahlien family activity; Mozzie is tied to this place too.

location.title: Tormsicle
location.content: Pirate-heavy island with loose jurisdiction (currently led by Soren Malsir). Main area is Everwater Bay. Active Yuan Ti issues. Eastern side linked to Golden Circle meetings and memory-wiping fog rumors.

item.title: Celestial Droplet
item.content: Only rumors at this point. Some relate it to a kids' book. Some attribute it to the dragon that attacked, which could be in Alsita, maybe the government stole it. 1 million gp bounty. Droplet with blue and purple tints. Emanates energy of storm clouds and arcana, magical and religious importance. Orphon linked it to post-Pale Silence changes around River of Souls beliefs and free will.

item.title: Random Monolith
item.content: Some form of ward/protection. The language cannot be understood. Rahkar's mind is clear when he's there.

item.title: White tentacle
item.content: Not much is known about this tentacle other than it was from the time of the Pale Silence; it was housed in the church but was taken away, and is now being taken to Pinchester. The dragon Rindos seems to be interested in it. The government is willing to pay 5000 gold per adventuring party to keep it safe and its secret kept.

item.title: Dagger that steal souls
item.content: It can steal and store souls. Right now there is a soul loose in Alsita. Was once asked to use this weapon against the demon known as Mozzie.

item.title: ellie dreadtooth ipad
item.content: A tablet that belongs to Elly that allows communication to Dreadtooth. Gill touched it and now Dreadtooth is looking for him.

item.title: Party Crasher
item.content:
Weapon (light hammer), (requires attunement)

Hidden in the rubble of the Tomb of Remembrance, Partycrasher is an expertly forged hammer engraved with goblin scripture. The hammer flies through the air with overwhelming force when thrown, being especially effective against structures and constructs.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You may make a ranged weapon attack with this weapon as a bonus action so long as the weapon isn't currently equipped. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d4 Force damage, or an extra 4d4 Force damage if the target is a Construct. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon reforms back in your hand (or wherever it was thrown from).

Sentience. Partycrasher is a sentient lawful neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 11, a Wisdom of 16, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak both Common and Goblin. While attuned or holding it, the wielder gains the ability to speak, read, and understand Goblin.

Happy Weapon, happy Warrior

item.title: The big book
item.content: A book co-authored by Thea and Shelly (Shelly made the science and Thea annotated). Currently it is in the possession of Gill.

item.title: Roger plushie
item.content: Plushie with familiar-like behavior. Follows in its own way and can absorb up to one instance of damage before dying. has bonded with gill, has been trying to get rid of it. unsuccessfully.

alsita.note: fountain that telaports you to an arena for fighting

alsita.note: owed and managed by the Dahlien, this tavern serves many Alsitian and a wonderful place to eat, also mozzie works there

alsita.note: The House of famouse hero and adventuter Talon.
